evidence.extraction: GET metadata and selected schema fields only; no servers, auth URLs, examples, credentials or inventory; sensitive/unneeded object properties omitted.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: The maximum number of items to return

sort.name: sort
sort.description: One or more properties to sort by in the form of property:direction where property is the full property name in dot notation and direction is either asc or desc. If no direction is provided, asc is assumed. Multiple sorts can be provided by separating them with a comma.

type.description:
Type of Ethernet port.
                        - '': Not specified
                        - 'T': Twisted Pair (RJ-45)
                        - 'SX': Multimode fiber
                        - 'LX': Single mode fiber

speed.description: Speed of the Ethernet port in Mbps

mode.description:
Wi-Fi mode.
                        - '': Not specified
                        - 'ad-hoc': Ad-Hoc mode
                        - 'managed': Managed mode
                        - 'master': Master mode
                        - 'repeater': Repeater mode
                        - 'secondary': Secondary mode
                        - 'monitor': Monitor mode
                        - 'auto': Automatic mode

network_port_list.description: JSON-encoded array of Network Port IDs that are part of this aggregate port

NetworkPortDialup.description: Connection by dial line - Dialup Port

speed.description: Speed of the Fiber Channel port in Mbps

iftype.description: The interface type as defined by IANA. See https://www.iana.org/assignments/smi-numbers/smi-numbers.xhtml
